lyrics:
[Intro: shimmering synth chords, bouncing bass, drum fill]

[Verse 1: wistful male tenor]
Pink sign buzzing over the door
Same two colors that we wore
Jelly shoes and a borrowed car
We thought we'd lit up every star

[Chorus: full indie-dance groove, harmonies]
We were neon
Pink and blue and seventeen
We were neon
Brightest thing I've ever been
Look at us, still a little bright
We were neon, and we are tonight

[Verse 2: voice warmer, guitar chiming]
Now it's reading glasses, sensible shoes
Nine o'clock and the early news
But you laugh, and there's that glow
Same as thirty years ago

[Chorus: full indie-dance groove, harmonies]
We were neon
Pink and blue and seventeen
We were neon
Brightest thing I've ever been
Look at us, still a little bright
We were neon, and we are tonight

[Instrumental: synth solo, handclaps]

[Outro: synth chords, the sign buzzing, flickering]
